schema_change.additive_extension_table: event_blobs(raw_digest PK, scope_id, body BLOB) in sqlite/repository.py EXTENSION_DDL
schema_change.rationale: target events table stores payload_digest but the base schema has no scoped body store for event payloads; extension mirrors the memory_records precedent
schema_change.atomic_write: ScopedRepository.record_observation_in() appends events inside an owner transaction so a domain mutation and its observation commit or roll back together

R5-RF07-06: the dcode extension API exposes register_tool only — no slash-command registration hook exists, so the native /cyrano monitor entry is reported unavailable rather than faked (test asserts the honest unavailable path)
not_established: native dcode runtime wiring of the observers into a live agent loop (observers are exercised against the real scoped SQLite ledger in-process; no live dcode session emitted events)
live provider usage/cost capture (usage handling is reducer-verified on stored events; no paid or real provider call was made)
native /trace /cost command integration with the Cyrano dashboard (commands exist natively; binding to Cyrano queries is integration-layer work)
exporter push to an external sink (export_bundle produces a verified local bundle; no network transmission)
review_findings: post-image review found export_bundle silently truncated at one 500-event page; fixed by paging the full timeline via ObservationQuery.iter_events with a stalled-cursor guard

post-image review found recover_orphans used a hardcoded producer_seq floor of 100000, which collides on a second recovery run over a different orphan set; fixed via DomainSink.next_producer_seq (ledger-wide max+1)
post-image review found observer self._seq counters collide after process restart because the ledger dedupes (producer, producer_seq) globally; observers now draw sequences from next_producer_seq
post-image review found build_report scanned only one timeline page; now iterates all events

post-image review found projection.summary() only flagged *.failed kinds; a terminal row with outcome=failed/error (e.g. test.finished) now counts as a first-observed-failure candidate, matching catalogue.is_failure_event
post-image review found reconcile_attempts dropped finish-only attempts from every bucket; a finish without its start is now flagged ordering_uncertain
authority_scope: event authority, scope ACL, redaction, idempotency, sequence ownership, unknown/partial accounting, bounded monitor projection, and read-only Textual screen verified at component level over the real scoped SQLite ledger
next_wp_impact: WP09/WP10 dispatch and runner can emit work.*, tool.*, and model.* events through DomainSink with atomic transitions; WP14 replay can consume ObservationQuery.iter_events and reconcile_attempts
